items.q: Yeah, I remember Bebe Ridgely. That's when they put the pelican up. Bebe Ridgely had that over in charge, when the pelican used to be there. He used to play that.

ctx.x: Do you remember Bebe Ridgely on trombone?
Yeah, I remember Bebe Ridgely. That's when they put the pelican up. Bebe Ridgely had that over in charge, when the pelican used to be there. He used to play that.
Another trombonist, did you ever hear Zoo Robertson?
